'''Ejector seats''' were a safety device built into most [[Starship/Legends|starships]], particularly [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and combat [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]]. An alternative to [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]], ejector seats could not protect against the vacuum of space or the elements, simply propelling a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] clear of a damaged vehicle.

==Design==
Ejector seats allowed a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or passenger to evacuate from a doomed vehicle and wait for rescue or reach a nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. They were also used within planetary [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]]. Activated either manually or by a dead-man's switch, the seat would be launched from the vehicle by single-use, high-output [[ion engine]]s. For atmospheric craft, the ejector seat was equipped with a [[Parachute/Legends|parachute]] or a [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]] for a soft landing.<ref name="EV" />

===Risks===
[[File:Klivian_leg.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] lost his right leg ejecting from a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]].]]
Ejector seats were not entirely safe; sometimes the pilot could get caught in the starfighter, or, in the case of [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]], collide with another ship. That could result in serious injury or [[Death/Legends|death]]. Also, the pilot was left vulnerable to the [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] with little protection other than a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]], whereas in an escape pod, ample supplies of food, [[Water/Legends|water]], and air were available. It was important to have rescue and recovery vehicles nearby to retrieve ejected pilots, who could often become lost in the vastness of space.
[[File:9eject.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Luke Skywalker ejects from a TIE Fighter.]]

==Alternatives==
Primarily, ejector seats served to provide for the survival of pilots, who were seen as more valuable and harder to replace than fighters. To that end, variations of escape pod/ejector seat combinations were tried, one design being utilized in the [[BTL-S8 K-wing assault starfighter]], which had a dual-cockpit design that could be entirely separated from the fighter's main body.

Some versions of [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wings]] could also have the whole cockpit separated, transforming it into a small pod.

==Behind the scenes==
During the scenes of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] being pursued through the asteroid field in [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']], tiny figures that are [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] pilots can supposedly be seen ejecting from their fighters just moments after the fighters collide with asteroids and explode.
